---
title: "7 Evaluate a single method"
link-citations: true
---

## Definition
These studies aim to assess a single method with respect to precision, bias, acceptance, variability introduced by methods users, or other outcomes. This type includes proof-of-concept studies that demonstrate whether a method can work in principle before larger-scale testing.

::: {.callout-tip appearance="minimal" collapse="true"}
## Boundaries with related objectives
[14 Assess variability of results across methodological choices](14variability.qmd): In O7, researchers evaluate one specific method, and the variability that users introduce when applying it can be one outcome of that evaluation. When researchers do not evaluate a specific method and instead study how much results vary across methodological choices, the objective becomes O14.
:::

## Typical approaches and corresponding examples
[Simulation studies](../approaches/2simulation.qmd): random-effects meta-analysis;[@Hartung2001a] false positives when conducting subgroup analysis.[@Brookes2001subgroup]

[Reliability and agreement studies](../approaches/4reliability.qmd): reliability when 6 raters applied a risk of bias tool to 60 observational studies;[@Kalaycioglu2023inter-rater] reliability when 12 raters applied a quality assessment tool for radiomics to 35 studies at two time points;[@AkinciDAntonoli2025reproducibility] agreement between nine research teams attempting to reproduce the same observational study;[@Ostropolets2023reproducible] agreement between reproduced and original analyses of 150 real-world evidence studies.[@Wang2022reproducibility]

[Qualitative studies](../approaches/7qualitative.qmd): focus group addressing the clarity of plain language recommendations in guidelines;[@Santesso2022focus] interviews with users of a new instrument addressing face validity.[@Schandelmaier2020development]

[Reviews of applied or planned methods](../approaches/9review-applied.qmd): concordance of target trial emulations with benchmark randomized controlled trials.[@Wang2026-bw]
